preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and len(stdin) > 0 and len(stdin) <= 5000000
preconditions.description: The input must be a non-empty string with a length not exceeding 5 million characters.
The input string must consist only of Latin letters and digits.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the palindrome degrees of all prefixes of the input string.
